trait.ISTJ: You're responsible and careful, handling things in a realistic, organized way. You value your word and see things through to the end — dependable through and through.
trait.ISFJ: You're warm and attentive, always looking out for the people around you. Responsible and devoted, you give the people you're with real peace of mind.
trait.INFJ: You combine deep insight with a warm heart. You understand people and the world on a deeper level, and you treasure meaningful relationships.
trait.INTJ: You're independent and insightful — a strategist who sees the big picture and works quietly toward your goals.
trait.ISTP: You're calm but hands-on, solving problems in a practical way. You love your freedom, but when it counts, you're as reliable as anyone.
trait.ISFP: You're gentle and sensitive, with a clear sense of your own world and taste. You respect other people's individuality just as they are.
trait.INFP: You're idealistic with a warm heart. Your values are clear, and you treat people with real sincerity.
trait.INTP: You're curious and logical — a thinker who loves exploring new ideas.
trait.ESTP: You're active and bold, living fully in the moment. Quick on your feet, you love being around people.
trait.ESFP: You're bright and full of energy, the one who brings joy to everyone around you. You live for the moment and love being with people.
trait.ENFP: You're passionate and creative, endlessly curious about people and ideas. You spread positive energy wherever you go.
trait.ENTP: You're witty and bold, thriving on new ideas and debate. You'd always rather explore new possibilities than stick to the mold.
trait.ESTJ: You're organized and decisive — a natural leader who sets a goal and drives it through.
trait.ESFJ: You're warm and sociable, and you love taking care of the people around you. Community and relationships matter deeply to you.
trait.ENFJ: You're warm and charismatic, drawn to leading and helping others. You genuinely root for people's growth.
trait.ENTJ: You're charismatic and driven — a born leader who moves people toward a goal.

compatible.ISTJ: Spontaneous, active ESTPs pair well with you — your stability gives them something to trust, and their free spirit brings energy into your life.
compatible.ISFJ: Bright, sociable ESFPs make a great match — they'll return your care and add joy to everyday life.
compatible.INFJ: Passionate, creative ENFPs are a great match — you'll recognize each other's depth and values and build a real bond.
compatible.INTJ: Quick-witted ENTPs bring energy to your ideas, and you'll enjoy stimulating conversations together.
compatible.ISTP: Organized, decisive ESTJs respect your freedom while adding some helpful structure to your life.
compatible.ISFP: Warm, sociable ESFJs understand your sensitivity well and give you a comfortable place to belong.

compatible.ESFP: Warm, caring ISFJs genuinely cherish your bright energy — a solid, dependable match.
compatible.ENFP: Deep, insightful INFJs understand your passion and can share real, meaningful conversations with you.
compatible.ENTP: Deep, strategic INTJs take your ideas seriously — a great intellectual match.
compatible.ESTJ: Relaxed, flexible ISTPs take your drive in stride — a comfortable match.
